signature.name: Helsinki Cathedral
signature.detail: The white neoclassical cathedral dominates Senate Square and is the city's most recognizable symbol. Climb the steps for views over the harbor; entry is free, but dress modestly and avoid visiting during services.

signature.name: Suomenlinna
signature.detail: This UNESCO-listed sea fortress on a cluster of islands is a must-see for its history, walls, and coastal walks. Take the 15-minute public ferry from Market Square (HSL ticket valid); go on a weekday morning to avoid crowds.

signature.name: Temppeliaukio Church
signature.detail: A unique church carved into solid rock with a copper dome, famous for its acoustics and architecture. There is a small entry fee; visit early or late to dodge tour groups, and check for concert schedules.

signature.name: Uspenski Cathedral
signature.detail: The red-brick Eastern Orthodox cathedral offers a striking contrast to its Lutheran counterpart and fine harbor views. Entry is free; dress respectfully (shoulders and knees covered) and note it may close for services.

transport: Single metro/tram ticket about $3.50; day pass $9-12
